in_marathi.name: Pashupati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of All Creatures
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pashupati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pashupati is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Pashu’ meaning animals and ‘Pat’ meaning master or protector. Pashupati is the Lord of all creatures and is considered as the protector and provider of all beings.
